surprise_limitation_note: Free FRED/BLS/BEA data provides realized series only, not historical survey consensus expectations. No historical consensus or surprise backtest is fabricated. An AR+seasonal Ridge baseline is tracked solely as an econometric benchmark (ar_seasonal_proxy), never as historical market consensus. Live surprise outputs require user- or calendar-supplied consensus_overrides.
alfred_initial_vintage_caveat: Training and backtest series come from latest-revised FRED observations (fred_macro_monthly.csv), not ALFRED output_type=4 initial-release vintages. High-revision series (PAYEMS, GDPC1, PCEPI, PCEPILFE, INDPRO, RSAFS) reflect post-revision history.

validation_design.tuning_scope: TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=4) strictly inside development split prior to holdout
validation_design.model_selection_rule: Minimum development walk-forward MAE (untouched holdout never inspected during selection)
validation_design.conformal_calibration: Strictly causal trailing-60 OOF nonconformity quantiles prior to each step t
validation_design.outlier_weighting: Causal recency + MAD dampening computed strictly from y_tr inside each fold
